events.description: The Maple Leafs visit the Avalanche at Ball Arena in Denver for an NHL regular-season game. Colorado beat Toronto 4-1 on Jan. 25 and leads the head-to-head. Nathan MacKinnon defends home ice against visiting star William Nylander in this game. (Hockey) - 2026-10-10
